I can help with this, but first I need to verify your account. Could you give me your last name and your licence plate, or your repair-order number (RO-######)?

I also need to correct my colleague's earlier message. I can't confirm the two-day delivery, the 20-minute installation time, or a price for the part or labour yet. A parts advisor will confirm availability, price, and whether we can install it, and I can pass your request to them once you're verified. The part you describe may be a different piece from the one you first mentioned, so the advisor can confirm that too.
